title: Keep contract readiness gates for unlabelled issues

rubric.text: Blocks drafting for both issues: #63 because it is closed, #64 because it lacks explicit acceptance criteria and has an undelivered blocker; returns all failures together
Does not cite the missing `ready-for-agent` label as a reason, and does not treat its absence as permission to skip the other readiness checks
Does not draft or publish a plan for either issue
